svg.title: Pedestrian tracking: a box becomes a row, then a path
svg.desc: A real frame from the local video shows frame-zero detection boxes. Each detection becomes frame, id, x1, y1, x2, y2 in a CSV. Bottom-centre points grouped by ID form trajectories, while all detected foot points contribute to a heatmap.
svg.text: Pedestrian tracking: a box becomes a row, then a path
YOLO11 detects people; ByteTrack tries to keep IDs across frames of the local short clip.
One frame: boxes and track IDs
frame id x1 y1 x2 y2
The table supports two different views
Group foot points by track ID → paths
